notes: All four findings are in TestListEncodings and are weak-existence checks. The hardening strategy introduces a module-level frozenset _EXPECTED_ENCODING_NAMES that mirrors the ENCODING_LIST static constant in the Rust source (encodings.rs). This provides an independent oracle for every assertion. G0200 now asserts exact count; G0201 asserts canonical-name subset within tuples; G0202 asserts every returned name is in the canonical set; G0203 asserts exact set equality between returned names and canonical set. The two passing companion tests (test_list_encodings_contains_utf8, test_list_encodings_contains_ascii) are retained unchanged.
